subject: English
passage: Vocal mimicry occurs when one individual reproduces sounds made by another individual of a different species. Studies of this behavior in birds have focused primarily on species in laboratory settings, but ornithologist Dr. Na-Yeon Seo and her colleagues have demonstrated that it can occur in natural bird populations as well. In their study, which examined a wild population of lyrebirds (Menura novaehollandiae) in Australia, the researchers further reported that vocal mimicry most commonly occurred in juvenile birds and during territorial disputes rather than courtship displays.
prompt: Which choice best describes the function of the first sentence in the text as a whole?

choices.A: It introduces a problem that is examined in the text.
choices.B: It makes a claim that is challenged in the text.
choices.C: It defines a phenomenon that is discussed in the text.
choices.D: It presents a hypothesis that is evaluated in the text.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer because it most accurately describes how the first sentence functions in the text as a whole. The first sentence introduces what vocal mimicry is, explaining that it occurs when an individual reproduces sounds made by another individual of a different species. The text goes on to describe Dr. Na-Yeon Seo and her colleagues' study of this phenomenon in a wild population of lyrebirds. According to the text, the study showed that natural bird populations experience vocal mimicry and that the behavior occurs most commonly in juvenile birds and during territorial disputes. Thus, the function of the first sentence is to define the phenomenon of vocal mimicry that is discussed in the text.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect because the first sentence doesn't present a claim but instead explains what vocal mimicry is. Moreover, the text doesn't challenge anything; it's an informative text that describes the findings of a research study about vocal behavior in wild bird populations.
